scenario: A service no imported library declares is refused, with a whole-library import in scope. A service takes no library qualifier, and a service name is looked up as written. `import ha` brings in library `ha`, which declares only `light.turn_on`. The rule writes `call weather.get_forecasts`, which no declaration names, so it is DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_SERVICE ([LCRS.10.4.2], [LADP.8.2.3]). PATH PINNED: `ladp_8_2_3_service` in dsc.validate, its bare arm, against the service table dsc.imports fills from the whole import closure (LGRA.10.1.6): a whole-library import brings every service under its own name and nothing else.
rules_ds:
import ha

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig
->
    call weather.get_forecasts location: "home" cooldown: 1_h

libraries.ha:
service light.turn_on:
    kwarg entity_id: String literal required
    no response
